verdict.rationale: GrowthBook docs explicitly describe environments (dev/staging/prod) that can enable/disable flags independently, and the SDK Connection Endpoint provides scoped, readonly API keys tied to project/environment for SDK use. Pricing tiers also mention 'Custom environments' as an upsell feature, confirming environment scoping is a core, documented capability. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of environment-scoped key rotation or isolation in practice, and detail on how many environments are supported at each plan tier.
